given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator is logged into the zone management module
given_when_then.when: The operator publishes a new version of a Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The new version becomes the active Service Area Definition immediately and the previous version is invalidated

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Assignment is being prepared for an address
given_when_then.when: The address falls outside the currently active Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The Order Allocation Engine rejects the Delivery Assignment and logs the rejection with the reason 'outside service zone'

given_when_then.given: A Service Area Definition is active
given_when_then.when: The Platform Operator modifies the Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The Travel time matrices are recalculated to reflect the updated route constraints

given_when_then.given: The system is configured to calculate estimates
given_when_then.when: A potential customer address is provided within a valid Delivery Zone Map
given_when_then.then: The system calculates and stores travel duration and distance estimates between the store location and the address

success_criteria: The new Service Area Definition version is active immediately upon publication without delay
The Order Allocation Engine rejects orders for addresses outside the active Service Area Definition
Travel time matrices are updated after any modification to the Service Area Definition
Modifications to Service Area Definitions are logged with a timestamp and Platform Operator identity
Travel duration and distance estimates are stored in the system for valid store location and customer address pairs
